data.name: Kudrat
data.gender_notes: Kudrat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'K-D-R', meaning power or ability. In Islamic literature, the name Kudrat is associated with divine power, strength, and might. The name Kudrat carries the meaning “Power, Might, Strength” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kudrat usually hope their child will grow to embody power, might, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the strength and power granted by God.
data.etymology: Kudrat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power, Might, Strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kudrat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
